thread:
noah: I opened a small cross-cutting docs PR to add a compact metering CSV example, a new repo-hosted panel asset, and concise SDK header snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4780. Need a quick pass because support wants a single reference we can link from tickets.

ivy: Nice. Can you paste the CSV header here so I can check it vs ingestion? We require `billing_event_id` and ISO UTC timestamps. Also please standardize on `tokens_consumed` everywhere.

noah: CSV header I added:

```csv
timestamp_iso,billing_event_id,org_id,plan,tokens_consumed,endpoint,response_code
```

sample row: `2026-06-10T16:45:00Z,evt_z9y8x7,org_21,pro,320,/v1/complete,200`

ben: Good. For SDK snippets, include Python and Node examples that read `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`, and mention `Retry-After` for 429s. Also add a one-line note that `Remaining` can briefly go negative under concurrency.

noah: Added a tiny python snippet and a node fetch example in `docs/snippets/rate_headers_samples.md`. Python example:

```python
import requests
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', json={'prompt':'hi'}, headers={'Authorization':'Bearer $KEY'})
print(resp.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit'))
print(resp.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Remaining'))
print(resp.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Reset'))
```

sofie: We should also explain burst credits in that docs section. Add a short paragraph and a tiny formula showing gross vs net tokens. For example: `net_tokens = tokens_consumed - burst_credit_applied`. Also show a 4-row mock snippet demonstrating a brief spike and how credits are applied.

noah: Done 14 added `examples/metering-burst-mini.csv` with 4 rows and a one-paragraph explanation. I also committed a panel JSON at `docs/assets/panels/usage-quota-illustration.json` that renders both gross and net series and includes an annotation series for burst credit events.

ivy: One nit: in `docs/pricing/tiers.md` we mention "per-minute enforcement" but the panel aggregates hourly. Please add a caution so readers don't misread the charts.

ben: Also ensure the panel groups plans in the order `free,pro,enterprise` so colors align with the text examples. I left a comment on the PR about legend ordering.

noah: Reordered plan buckets and adjusted colors to brand palette. Fixed `tiers.md` caution note. I also updated `docs/billing/overview.md` to replace an old external Grafana link with the repo asset path so linkcheck stays green when previewing offline.

docs-ci-bot: CI report: markdown lint passed, linkcheck passed, panel JSON schema validated.

sofie: Quick review from my side: wording suggestion in the burst paragraph (flip the sentence that introduces gross vs net). Small doc nit in the snippet file: use `X-RateLimit-Reset` as seconds-since-epoch (clarify format).

noah: Addressed both nits, pushed a small follow-up commit. PR description lists: `examples/metering-burst-mini.csv`, `assets/panels/usage-quota-illustration.json`, `snippets/rate_headers_samples.md`, and minor edits to `pricing/tiers.md` and `billing/overview.md`.

ivy: I'll do a final content pass tomorrow morning. Aim to merge by Friday if CI stays green.

ben: LGTM pending Ivy.

noah: Thanks all 10 adding a changelog line: "docs: add compact metering CSV, SDK rate header snippets, and in-repo panel asset; clarify burst credits and quota aggregation"

(END)
